sources.title: Allegheny County official results, May 19, 2026 General Primary (election 126196, version 374579)
Summary CSV export of those results (126196-374579-summary.zip, generated 2026-06-08)

notes: Built by war_map/tools/committee/run.mjs from the official May 19, 2026 General Primary results for every Republican county committee contest (2654 contests). A seat is filled when a named candidate had the most votes, and holder is that winner's name as printed in the results; empty when no candidate was on the ballot and no write-in votes were cast; unknown when only write-in votes were cast (public results don't name write-in winners, who may also have declined) or when the result was tied or a named candidate had zero votes. Appointments made since the election are not counted. Clarity blocks scripted and headless access (HTTP 403), so the Summary CSV export is downloaded by a person from the results page Downloads menu.
